tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Searches the current job listings on Faith Friendly Jobs by keyword, category, remote and location, and returns each job with a link to its page on Faith Friendly Jobs.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Returns one current Faith Friendly Jobs job by its id, with a sanitized description of up to 8,000 characters and a link to its page.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Lists the job categories on Faith Friendly Jobs with how many current listings each one has.
